findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "utilities" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: json_validate, base64_decode, url_decode, url_parse, hmac, text_extract, html_to_text, xml_to_json, yaml_to_json, barcode, csv_to_markdown, html_table_to_json, magic_8_ball · Private data: pack_hash_toolbox, pack_json_toolbox, base64_decode, hmac, slug, text_extract, text_diff, ip_info, jwt_decode, mime, xml_to_json, json_schema, yaml_to_json, json_to_yaml, phone_validate, vin, random_password, ping · Public sink: hmac, text_extract, ip_cidr, markdown_to_html, calc_tip, json_schema, phone_validate, text_keyword_density, html_table_to_json, echo · Destructive: json_format, json_minify, cron_next, validate_iban, validate_luhn, phone_validate, bic_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: json_validate, base64_decode, url_decode, url_parse, hmac, text_extract, html_to_text, xml_to_json, yaml_to_json, barcode, csv_to_markdown, html_table_to_json, magic_8_ball · Private data: pack_hash_toolbox, pack_json_toolbox, base64_decode, hmac, slug, text_extract, text_diff, ip_info, jwt_decode, mime, xml_to_json, json_schema, yaml_to_json, json_to_yaml, phone_validate, vin, random_password, ping · Public sink: hmac, text_extract, ip_cidr, markdown_to_html, calc_tip, json_schema, phone_validate, text_keyword_density, html_table_to_json, echo · Destructive: json_format, json_minify, cron_next, validate_iban, validate_luhn, phone_validate, bic_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
